text: Whiteboat for DeepSeek Harness 是一款面向 DSH 网页客户端的交互式水面界面插件。它通过 DSH 的 sidebar action 与 settings slot 接入页面，让用户先在水面场景中移动小船、打开原生输入框，再把非空消息交给 DSH 会话。主要功能包括指针与手机漫游导航、水面音效和开关、小船速度设置，以及提交后的涟漪转场。适合想在开始对话前获得轻松视觉入口的 DSH 用户；无需额外 API 密钥，依赖 DSH 自身工作区与会话。

Whiteboat for DeepSeek Harness adds a water scene to DSH web. Its sidebar entry opens a surface where a boat follows pointer or mobile navigation. Users can open the native composer, send a message, adjust boat speed, and control water audio. No extra API key is needed.
想在开始 DSH 对话前先有个安静的水面场景。
能不能让 DSH 里的小船跟着鼠标移动？
我想用手机触控在水面界面里漫游。
给 DSH 的新会话加一个轻松的视觉入口。
希望输入消息后有水波转场，再进入原生会话。
想关闭水面环境音，或者调节小船跟随速度。
I want a calm visual scene before starting a DSH conversation.
Can the boat follow my pointer in the DSH web interface?
Whiteboat 的「水面入口」在 DSH 网页侧栏提供打开入口。点击后显示水面场景；准备输入时连接当前或最近工作区，并打开一个空白 Session。
Whiteboat 的「小船导航」让小船跟随指针移动，并在手机模式下自动漫游。用户移动指针或触控目的地后，小船逐步驶向目标，速度可在设置中调整。
Whiteboat 的「原生会话提交」通过 DSH 原生输入框接收草稿；只有非空消息才作为首条 Prompt 送入会话，提交成功后再转入 DSH 原生 Conversation。
Whiteboat 的「水面音效控制」播放随小船移动变化的水声。用户可在页面声音按钮或设置中开关音效；页面隐藏时暂停，离开界面时清理播放资源。

whiteboat-dsh README · Whiteboat for DeepSeek Harness：Whiteboat is growing in the DeepSeek Harness ecosystem. The `0.1.x` release begins with a quiet water surface; later Whiteboat capabilities will join this same package instead of becoming separate top-level repositories.

whiteboat-dsh README · First slice: water surface：The first slice opens an unbranded water surface where you can pause or type before beginning a real DSH Session. Merely looking at the surface creates no Session, Prompt, AI call, or write. Opening the composer prepares at most one blank Session; only an explicit non-empty send admits a Prompt.

whiteboat-dsh README · First slice: water surface：The surface reuses Whiteboat's shared water field, boat, pointer navigation, mobile roaming, wake intensity, and celestial projection. Its composer, Workspace, Agent preset, commands, permissions, model, reasoning level, draft, and send lifecycle remain native to DSH.

whiteboat-dsh README · First slice: water surface：The water surface includes the same gentle, offline water recording used by Whiteboat Home. Sound fades with boat movement. Use the speaker button in the upper right or “白舟 → 水面 → 水面音效” in settings to mute it; DSH remembers the choice. If the browser blocks autoplay, an ordinary click, touch, or key press starts the sound. Leaving the surface or hiding the page stops playback. No microphone access is involved. Sending an idea also drops one randomly chosen stone into the water. Audio attribution is in [AUDIO-LICENSE.md](AUDIO-LICENSE.md).

whiteboat-dsh README · First slice: water surface：After an explicit send, a circular ripple expands from the centre of the native Conversation composer, then the water surface yields to DSH's native Conversation detail. Messages, run phases, tools, and agents stay in DSH's detail surface. Obsidian's ripple is a Canvas-node context surface and does not become a DSH node view; this package does not copy Canvas nodes, edges, or ripple state.
whiteboat-dsh README · Settings / 配置：打开 DSH 设置，在“白舟”页面可调整“小船跟随速度”。默认值为 `100%`，可在 `50%` 到 `200%` 之间调整；修改后会立即用于指针跟随、点击或触控目的地以及手机漫游，并保存在 DSH 的设置文档中。该设置只改变小船的航行速度，不改变水面、投影、Canvas 或 Session 语义。

whiteboat-dsh README · Installation / 安装：准备环境：Node.js `>=20.19` 与 pnpm。直接把 GitHub Release 中的预构建包安装到 DSH 的 `web` profile：

```sh
pnpm dlx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2 plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Circleyan/whiteboat-dsh/releases/download/v0.1.3/whiteboat-dsh-0.1.3.tgz
```

然后启动 DSH：

```sh
pnpm dlx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2 --profile web
```

DSH 会打开浏览器；也可以按终端打印的本地地址手动访问。若已经全局安装同版本 DSH，可把上面命令中的 `pnpm dlx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2` 替换为 `dsh`。

whiteboat-dsh README · 更新：从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Circleyan/whiteboat-dsh/releases) 选择新版本，并用对应 tarball URL 再次执行 `plugin --profile web add`。更新后重新启动 DSH。

卸载时运行：

```sh
pnpm dlx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2 plugin --profile web remove whiteboat-dsh
```

whiteboat-dsh README · Mobile input：The DSH water surface provides text input on mobile. It does not render a microphone control, request microphone permission, or call browser speech-recognition APIs. Features exposed by a user's operating-system keyboard are controlled by the operating system and browser, not by this package, and are not part of the DSH capability contract.

whiteboat-dsh README · Development：Source development currently requires access to the pinned private `Circleyan/whiteboat-core` submodule. Runtime users installing the prebuilt GitHub Release do not need that repository access.

Clone with the shared capability submodule:

```sh
git clone --recurse-submodules git@github.com:Circleyan/whiteboat-dsh.git
cd whiteboat-dsh
npm install
npm test

whiteboat-dsh README · Development：`npm install` builds the exact `whiteboat-core` submodule revision before DSH tests or bundling. The released DSH client bundle contains the required core code and has no runtime dependency on the private submodule.

whiteboat-dsh README · Development：The exact `vendor/whiteboat-core` gitlink owns the shared non-integral-height water wrapping fix, common boat-speed normalization contract, candidate design-system foundation, and host-neutral water sound playback. Host installation and runtime acceptance remain independent from that core proof.

The current compatibility target is `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.1-rc.2`. DSH is still in developer preview, so host compatibility is verified independently for every release.

whiteboat-dsh README · Maintainer release：Ordinary pushes and pull requests run verification only. A public package is created from GitHub Actions with the manually dispatched `Release DSH` workflow on `main`; the entered version must already match `package.json`. The workflow resolves the exact `whiteboat-core` gitlink, reruns tests and build, creates the `.tgz`, waits at the `dsh-release` environment gate, requires its `DSH_RELEASE_GATE=enabled` variable, and then creates the GitHub Release. It does not run `npm publish`.

whiteboat-dsh README · Roadmap boundary：Water surface is the first released feature, not the identity of this repository. Future features live under `src/features/` or equivalent host adapters and reuse `whiteboat-core` when their product semantics are genuinely shared with Obsidian. Feature parity is not automatic: every capability keeps its own DSH lifecycle and runtime proof.
whiteboat-dsh README · 本地视觉调整 · 2026-09-24：3D 小船采用主舟确认的亮色 C / 暗色 E：白天舱内反差更柔和，夜间船身适度提亮；太阳 / 月亮方向、云遮明暗和水面投影继续参与画面。夜间材质与 Obsidian 一致。这组调整已随 `0.1.2` 进入源码与预构建包；真实客户端的视觉验收仍是独立门禁。
